claims: One query over the ontology replaces lookups across three tools
Constraining an LLM with a type system yields a deterministic graph
Validating every application against the catalogue keeps junk out of the graph
Capping dependency edges stops popular services from dominating
Ordered, sequential enrichment buys accuracy worth its cost in speed
Known causal pairs plus timing and severity recover causal chains
Each turn of the flywheel leaves the system better for the next
The most valuable edges come from human discussion
If you want to build one
Without the right context, agents hallucinate
Specialists read each other's findings through the ontology alone
The graph absorbs the hour or two spent assembling context
Putting the graph to work, Fig 3
Best-effort enrichment degrades the graph but never blocks it
